title: Social Media Marketing Agency Egypt: What Actually Drives Sales
description: What separates a real social media marketing agency in Egypt from one that just posts content — strategy, paid/organic integration, and revenue-focused reporting.
bodyHtml:
Every business in Egypt claims to “do social media.” Very few actually run it as a system that drives sales. If you’re evaluating a social media marketing agency in Egypt, here’s what separates agencies that post content from agencies that build growth.

What a Real Social Media Marketing Agency Delivers

  • Strategy before content — a content pillar structure tied to actual business goals, not a random posting calendar
  • Platform-specific creative — Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Facebook each need different formats and pacing, not one asset repurposed everywhere
  • Paid + organic integration — organic builds trust, paid social scales what’s already working; treating them separately wastes budget
  • Community management — responding to DMs and comments fast enough to actually close sales, especially for COD-heavy markets like Egypt
  • Reporting tied to revenue — followers and likes are vanity metrics; leads, orders, and cost per acquisition are what matter

Why Egypt’s Social Media Landscape Is Different

A huge share of e-commerce and service sales in Egypt still close through Messenger and WhatsApp rather than a checkout page. That means your social media agency needs a process for capturing and following up on DM-based leads — not just a content calendar. Agencies that only think in terms of “likes and reach” miss where the actual sales happen.

How to Evaluate a Social Media Agency

Ask for real performance data from existing accounts they manage — follower growth alone means nothing. Look for case studies showing engagement-to-lead conversion, and ask directly how they handle COD order tracking and Messenger-based sales funnels, since that’s where most Egyptian brands actually lose revenue.
